title: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose you are invited to put forward a proposal to the university on how to make students' campus life easier. You are now to write an essay to make your proposal. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but not more than 180 words.
reference: I am honored to submit a proposal on how to make students' campus life easier. As daily routines grow more demanding, small improvements in campus services can save students considerable time and energy. First, the university could develop a one-stop mobile app that integrates course schedules, room bookings, and exam arrangements. This would spare students the trouble of switching between multiple platforms. Second, extending library opening hours and adding more self-study spaces during examination periods would reduce overcrowding. Third, improving shuttle-bus frequency between teaching buildings and dormitories would make commuting less stressful. These practical measures, if implemented, would significantly ease students' daily pressures. I sincerely hope the university will consider this proposal and take steps toward a more convenient campus life.
keyPoints: 落实首段功能：点明身份、目的与背景。首句 I am honored to submit a proposal on... 直 接回应 put forward a proposal to the university on how to make students' campus life easier，点 明受邀者身份与提案主题；第二句用 Small improvements... can save... 为背景铺垫，避免开头冗长。
主体段三条建议均具体可操作。First... Second... Third... 分别给出APP整合、学习空间、校园 交通三项措施，每项都紧跟一句理由，扣住 easier 这一核心。
结尾总结并礼貌呼吁。These practical measures, if implemented... 总结价值，I sincerely hope... 礼貌呼吁学校考虑，未引入新内容，收束自然。
